name: Network-based common-disease gene prioritization
model_likelihood: Neighbor overlap evaluated by a hypergeometric test; no phenotype sampling likelihood stated
inference_algorithm: RWR expansion; GSEA-like peak cutoff; overlap; neighbor-enrichment testing; Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment
estimand: Neighbor-enrichment scores and candidate common-disease driver genes
data_input: Disease-associated gene sets and a high-confidence STRING PPI network
tunable_settings: STRING confidence cutoff >0.900; RWR restart 0.7; successive-step tolerance 1E-6

name: Random walk with restart
model_likelihood: Binary PPI adjacency normalized column-wise defines graph transitions; no phenotype sampling likelihood stated
inference_algorithm: Uniform seed initialization; repeated neighbor visits with restart until the stated successive-step tolerance
estimand: Stabilized node probabilities for candidate disease-gene ranking
data_input: PPI graph and disease seed genes
